method: Expected salary is an estimate unless an employer-published amount exists. Prefer relevant company employee reports; otherwise use a documented India role/experience market comparator. These are not employer offers or take-home pay. Market estimates do not assert company-specific knowledge. Where finite experience spans source bands, use the full envelope; for open-ended requirements use the minimum band. Title-only comparisons and small samples are explicitly recorded. No currency conversion, arbitrary startup multiplier or invented range. Monthly internship stipends stay monthly. Pay basis is preserved internally; visible UI shows Expected salary and the amount only.

excluded_evidence.reason: Gross-monthly methodology conflicts with table magnitudes; annual/monthly basis could not be resolved.
